lines.text: A white spot not deeper than the skin, with no white hair, means the priest isolates him three days.
If the sore has faded and not spread at the second checkup, the priest pronounces him clean.
If the disease covers all the skin and has all turned white, the priest pronounces the person clean.
A diseased person wears torn clothes, covers his mouth, cries out 'Unclean,' and lives alone in a place outside Jericho.
If the mildew has spread by day seven, the item is harmful and unclean and must be burned.
